text:
maria: Quick sync: finalizing alpha scope for observability console. Goal: single-page dashboard + trace tags + sampled cost rollups for pilots. Owners?
rahul: I can own trace hooks. Plan: add tags (model,route,tenant,token_count). Default sample=1% + force-capture on error.
anya: UX will ship Overview with 3 tiles: latency p95/p99, sampled cost trend, top error traces. Keep interactions read-only for alpha.
sam: Ops constraints: retention default 7d, full traces only when error=true. Canary: 2% traffic, rollback if median latency regresses >1% or telemetry lag >30s for 10m.
maria: Alpha launch criteria: 1) Overview visible for pilot orgs, 2) trace metadata emitted, 3) cost rollups CSV for admins, 4) alerts for error-slices, 5) canary + rollback doc.
ops-bot: ops-bot: feature-flag "obs-alpha" created.
rahul: Dev notes: make span metadata <200 bytes and batch to telemetry producer to limit RPCs.
anya: Mock ready Tuesday; will add tooltips for sampling & cost-estimate.
maria: Ok locking scope. Owners file short RFCs and perf checks by Friday. :thumbsup:
